title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the gap in existing governance, even though Microsoft documents policy enforcement for MCP requests and spending controls for Work IQ API usage. It also incorrectly applies the service report's one-day restriction to every usage report; Microsoft now documents monthly and timestamp-window reports too.
